title: Kamailio World 2024: Selection Of Presentations
html:
A selection of accepted presentations and speakers has been published by Kamailio World Conference web site. The sessions cover topics from testing, scalability and security to accounting, billing, webrtc as well as 4/5G and space mission control.

The open discussion “Ask Me Anything” continues to be part of the event, allowing everyone to ask the developers about how to use Kamailio or to solve specific problems for SIP routing. Other interactive sessions enable the attendees to participate actively during event, presenting what they do in the RTC space as part of the session “5 Minutes 5 Slides”, or show exciting demos during “Dangerous Demos”.

You can see more details at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k2024/schedule/

Looking forward to meeting many of you in Berlin, Germany, during April 18-19, 2024, at the next Kamailio World Conference!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
